findings.text: The company has the status 'administration' and an insolvency case on record where administration started on 12 December 2025.
Accounts are overdue with the next due date being 30 December 2025, and the last accounts were made up to 30 December 2023.
The confirmation statement is overdue with the next due date being 5 June 2026, and the last statement was made up to 22 May 2025.
There are 2 outstanding charges registered against the company, in addition to 0 part-satisfied and 2 satisfied charges.
The two current directors are linked to 11 other companies, including one in administration and three dissolved entities.
There are 2 current persons with significant control: HOLDINGS LTD. and CANARY-A27, who holds 25 to 50 percent of shares and voting rights.
One registered office address change was filed on 29 December 2025, but there have been no officer appointments or resignations since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 441 is in administration with overdue accounts and confirmation statements, alongside outstanding charges and directors linked to other insolvencies.
